title: oenothera fusca
intro: Oenothera fusca, commonly known as the evening primrose, is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the family Onagraceae. The health benefits of Oenothera fusca include its potential to alleviate symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and mood swings, due to its high content of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera fusca include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions, including eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera fusca include GLA, linoleic acid, and other essential fatty acids, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
